reference_audio.note: Optional: omit for a built-in `voice` (or the checkpoint's default voice).  For cloning, 5--30 s of a single speaker works well.  The vocoder conditions on the first 10 s of the clip and loops shorter clips internally; the speaker embedding and the in-context prompt see the whole clip.  Omitting `reference_text` makes the engine load Whisper and transcribe the clip in English mode -- supply it for non-English references.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to synthesize, e.g. 'Hello there'.  Expression markup is understood inside the text: a leading [emotion] tag (angry/contemplative/excited/joyful/mundane/nervous/sad/stern/surprised/tender), inline <event> tags (gasp/giggle/growl/gulp/laugh/pause/scoff/sigh/sob/um) and (((emphasis))) spans steer delivery (beta).

parameters.name: audio_base64
parameters.description: Reference voice sample (5--30 s of a single speaker) as a base64 string, to clone that speaker instead of a built-in voice.  Any container soundfile can decode (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, ...).  Mutually exclusive with `voice`; omit both to use the checkpoint's default voice.

parameters.name: reference_text
parameters.description: Exact transcript of the reference clip.  Strongly recommended: when omitted the engine transcribes the clip with Whisper, which runs in English mode -- non-English references need this field.  Only accepted together with `audio_base64`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. 'en' or 'zh'.  Accepted for API consistency but not forwarded -- the engine has no language parameter; the *speaker* carries the language (built-in voices named after a language, e.g. 'German', or your own reference clip).  Omitted or empty defaults to 'en'.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility (the engine seeds its sampler with it).  If omitted, a random seed in [1, 1000] is chosen and echoed in the response.

parameters.name: voice
parameters.description: Built-in voice name from the loaded model (kitten-tts-2 offers 115, e.g. 'Bruno' -- the checkpoint default -- 'Bella', or language-named voices such as 'German').  Mutually exclusive with `audio_base64`; unknown names are rejected (422).  Omit both to use the checkpoint's default voice.

parameters.name: preset
parameters.description: Decoding preset from the loaded model (kitten-tts-2 offers 'stable' (the default: temperature 0.8, top_p 0.8, top_k 50) and 'expressive' (temperature 0.9, top_p 0.9)).  Unknown names are rejected (422).

parameters.name: normalize
parameters.description: Expand written forms ('$12.50' -> 'twelve dollars fifty cents') before synthesis (engine default).  The normalizer is English-tuned and mangles other languages -- disable it for non-English text.

parameters.name: max_new_tokens
parameters.description: Per-chunk token budget (engine default 1000; 25 tokens is about one second of audio).  Long text is sentence-chunked; each chunk gets its own budget.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Sampling temperature, overriding the preset (preset defaults: stable 0.8, expressive 0.9).

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Top-k sampling cutoff, overriding the preset (default 50; 0 disables top-k).

parameters.name: min_p
parameters.description: Min-p sampling threshold, overriding the preset (default 0.0).
